title: Fetching and Pulling
objective: Have a clone push a teammate's change to the shared copy, then pull it into the original and print the history.
hint: Set up the shared copy and the clone as before. Then Set-Location into the clone, Add-Content, git add, git commit -q, git push -q, and Set-Location back to C:\Development\git-practice. Then git pull -q --ff-only origin main, and Write-Output (git log --format=%s).
